column4: cleat#3740: this engine test opens testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) directly, with no t.Run dialect loop, so in a job that configures no PostgreSQL it skips as one test. The job configures only its own dialect, so exactly this function skips. Measured by name, with one non-PostgreSQL DSN set at a time: env -i HOME=$HOME PATH=$PATH CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL=<dsn> go test ./engine/ -run TestAStoreReadsOnlyItsOwnTenantsDefinitionEvenThroughARoleThatBypassesRLS -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one, and the same with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL.
